Only two texts are held: the 1962 Constitution (with its 2002 revision) and loi n° 1.362 on money laundering (18 versions, 2009 to 2025), both with in-force history and matching Légimonaco in the checks. None of the six main codes, no labour law, no other loi or ordonnance souveraine and no case law are held.
